0022600039.text: The Rockets host the Jazz in their 13th game of the season, with Houston at 8-3 overall, 5-1 at home, and on a one-game winning streak after going 7-3 over their last ten. They sit 2nd in the Southwest, 1.5 games back, and 5th in the West, while Utah is 1-10 overall, 0-5 on the road, and on a nine-game losing streak, placing 15th in the West. Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), and Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Lauri Markkanen (hand fracture). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Rockets won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 140-106 home win on April 3, 2026.
